releaseNotes:
Fixes and improvements

Ticketmaster

• Added automatic handoff evidence recording to help investigate tickets disappearing after Get Tickets. Diagnostics include manual click timing, remaining hold time, page transitions and recorded extension clicks.
• The latest handoff failure survives reloads and later runs. Clear log keeps it; Clear evidence deletes it.
• Cancelling held tickets returns to Ready without restarting clicking or showing an unnecessary page-change warning. Intentional cancellation is distinguished from a suspected failed handoff.
• Historical reservation cards stay hidden while saved details remain available in diagnostics. Copy ticket details no longer falls back to stale historical details.
• Copied ticket details use 2x tickets / 1x ticket and omit unknown totals while preserving actual totals.
• Low-demand resale sign-in triggers a notification and stops automatic clicking instead of remaining on a stale reconnecting/requesting status. Existing alert settings apply.
• Selected event, quantity, section, row and per-ticket price remain visible and copyable through the recognized sign-in handoff and checkout. Captured selections are not proof of a current hold or purchase; login and payment remain manual.
• Minimum quantity controls single-ticket eligibility automatically: 1 allows singles; 2 or higher excludes them. Fixed quantity is unchanged.
• Simplified the category label to Lower Level without changing reviewed grouping or matching safeguards.

Ticketek Marketplace

• Improved interaction detection so unrelated information/help controls and focusing unchanged inputs do not pause retries.
• Genuine listing selections, Buy actions, navigation and selection-control changes still pause safely.
• Added a final listing identity, quantity, price and event check immediately before automatic Buy, including after asynchronous state saving.
• Diagnostics identify interaction-pause triggers with the action/control type, event type, attempt, phase and matching-listing count.
• Replaced misleading manual-interaction wording with Page interaction detected and a recognized trigger description.

Reliability and privacy

• Bounded evidence recording avoids repeatedly saving unchanged handoff states.
• No credentials, payment information or automatic diagnostic uploads. Marketplace interaction evidence excludes typed values, arbitrary control labels, URLs and coordinates, and lasts for the current page document.
• Regression checks use mocked pages, not live reservations or purchases. The rare Ticketmaster Get Tickets failure and the exact trigger in the older Marketplace report remain unconfirmed.

Reload Clickerist and refresh your ticket tabs after updating. Approve the Ticketmaster sign-in-site permission if prompted; it detects navigation without inspecting login forms. If a Marketplace pause recurs, copy diagnostics before refreshing.

Found a bug or have a feature request? Send feedback through Clickerist. For bug reports, include your version, steps to reproduce, a screenshot and Copy diagnostics where available. Review diagnostics before sharing.
